question: I'd love to know Emilia-tan's Top 3 moments when she thought, “I did something bad...”
answer:
First of all, Emilia isn't very good at lying. Whenever she lies, her stomach starts to ache.

Next would be when she occasionally sneaks a bite of the snacks Puck keeps in her bag for her. She must have gotten a little hungry and eaten some. (laughs)

And finally, basically whenever she fails to follow Puck's instructions.

Puck tells her, “Lia, you have to behave so you can become cute,” but sometimes she ends up having a snack anyway... That said, it's not like she's secretly eating by herself. It's more like Petra will invite her with something like, “Emilia-sama, let's have a little something,” and Emilia can't bring herself to refuse...
